title: 第四章 初级变异体？
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林夕听到了他们的窃窃私语，大概有4，5个人在哪里说话...

其中一个男生说道：“怎么办，丧尸全部围过来了。”

另外一个男生说道：“要不然我们备上超级多的物资，然后把他们两个推出去算了。”

一个女生说道：“这样不好吧，我们都是同学。”

第一个说话的男生说道：“你要是觉得不忍心，你可以跟他们一起。”

替另外两个女生说话的女生顿时吓得不敢说话

后面的对话因为丧尸逐渐增多的原因，嘈杂的声音导致林夕有些听不太清了。

林夕看着越来越多的丧尸慢慢的接近小卖铺。

林夕猛地看见其中有一个女丧尸的气息尤为特殊

林夕眼睛一瞪不可置信的喃喃自语道：“初级变异体？这怎么可能这才是病毒爆发的第一天啊。”

只见那群丧尸都逐渐的向初级变异体的女丧尸靠近

林夕并没有再管，刚准备走开去寻找新的目标的完成任务的时候

突然系统提示音再次响起

“突发任务拯救超市中的马洁”

“任务成功奖励经验+500附魔兵器一件”

“任务失败惩罚经验-2000收回系统所给出的所有物品（包括技能）”

林夕顿时瞪大了眼睛，在心里不可思议的说道：“这还带临时发布任务的？”

随后林夕便看向围在门口的丧尸。林夕想了又想突然想到小卖铺好像还有个后门

于是林夕慢慢的向后门摸去，缓缓地推开后门，走了进来

林夕便看到了刚才窃窃私语的几个人

几个人见到林夕突然的出现，顿时全部慌了神，其中为首的一个男生

颤颤巍巍的拿着一根棒球棍指着林夕。

林夕没有说话，缓缓地举起了手中的刀。

那个男生看到林夕手中的刀顿时慌了神。

手上劲儿一松只听砰的一生闷响，棒球棍掉在了地上。

门口聚集的丧尸听到了动静，顿时狂躁了起来，疯狂的用头撞门，撞窗户。

林夕瞪了那个男生一眼随即开口小声的说道：“谁叫马洁？”

旁边不远处坐着的三个女生中的一个穿着校服的扎着高马尾的女生缓缓地站了起来

开口说道：“我就是马洁，请问你是？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Xi heard their whispers. There were about 4 or 5 people talking somewhere...

One of the boys said: "What should we do? All the zombies are surrounding us."

Another boy said: "How about we prepare a lot of supplies and push them out."

A girl said: "Isn't this good? We are all classmates."

The first boy to speak said, "If you feel you can't bear it, you can join them."

The girl who was speaking for the other two girls was suddenly too frightened to speak.

Due to the increasing number of zombies, Lin Xi had trouble hearing the subsequent conversation due to the loud noise.

Lin Xi watched as more and more zombies slowly approached the small shop.

Lin Xi suddenly saw one of the female zombies with a particularly special aura.

Lin Xi's eyes widened and she murmured in disbelief: "Primary mutant? How is it possible that this is the first day of the virus outbreak?"

I saw the group of zombies gradually approaching the female zombie of the primary mutant

Lin Xi didn't care anymore. She was just about to walk away to find a new goal and complete the task.

Suddenly the system beep sounded again

"Unexpected mission to save Ma Jie in the supermarket"

"Mission success reward experience + 500 enchanted weapons"

"Mission failure penalty experience - 2000 recovery of all items (including skills) given by the system"

Lin Xi's eyes suddenly widened and she said in disbelief, "Is this a temporary mission?"

Then Lin Xi looked at the zombies surrounding the door.Lin Xi thought about it and suddenly thought that the small shop seemed to have a back door.

So Lin Xi slowly reached for the back door, slowly opened the back door, and walked in.

Lin Xi saw the people who were whispering just now

When several people saw Lin Xi's sudden appearance, they all panicked. One of the boys in the lead

Tremblingly, he pointed at Lin Xi with a baseball bat.

Lin Xi said nothing and slowly raised the knife in his hand.

The boy panicked when he saw the knife in Lin Xi's hand.

As soon as his hand relaxed, he heard a muffled thud, and the baseball bat fell to the ground.

The zombies gathered at the door heard the movement, and suddenly became manic, banging their heads on the door and windows crazily.

Lin Xi glared at the boy and then whispered, "Who's name is Ma Jie?"

One of the three girls sitting not far away, wearing a school uniform and a high ponytail, stood up slowly.

He opened his mouth and said, "I am Ma Jie, who are you?"
